title: Heavy rain and distant rolling thunder
role: Full sustained natural heavy rainfall with a distant deep rolling thunder body
prompt: TrackType: SFX, High fidelity natural outdoor storm recording. A dense sustained heavy rainfall pours evenly onto forest earth and soft leaves, thousands of fine overlapping water impacts make a full continuous natural rain wash with slow organic changes in density. In the middle of the recording a distant very deep rolling thunder gently swells and rumbles with a broad low resonant 80 to 200 Hz body, receding slowly under the unbroken heavy rainfall. Rounded dark distant thunder, smooth low rolling pressure without sharp nearby lightning cracks. Wide clean open air field recording, stable rain throughout, no voices, music, machines or birds. Length: 30 seconds.
backend: Official MLX local inference on Apple Silicon
processing: Official pipeline output preserved as stereo44100Hz32-bit float WAV without clipping or normalization. No reverb, compression, mixing or post-effects added. Browser copy normalized separately.
listeningReview: Technical validity checked. Perceptual prompt adherence requires audition.
